subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining #44431 browser automation slice should the browser plugin own next, and should the umbrella be split before implementation?
rationale: Current main shipped selector and batch groundwork, but the remaining requests change model-facing tool shape, browser state signals, and automation semantics in ways that require maintainer API direction.

options.title: Split And Prioritize State Signals
options.body: Create focused follow-ups for stale refs, readiness, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker, and action-diff signals before attempting more batch or CDP surface.

options.title: Finish Model-Facing Batch Contract
options.body: Treat batch as the next slice by adding schema/docs/model guidance for nested actions and validating managed-profile behavior.

options.title: Close Umbrella After Filing Narrow Issues
options.body: Retire #44431 only after each remaining useful request has a canonical issue or is explicitly rejected as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Split And Prioritize State Signals
recommendation.body: Create focused follow-ups for stale refs, readiness, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker, and action-diff signals before attempting more batch or CDP surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser plugin/runtime architecture history makes this the best available owner for choosing the browser-plugin API boundary.
